title: Nf Maxorder Oracles
objective: Implement the reproducible multi-oracle maximal-order manifest, persistent adapters, normalization, verification, profiling, and machine-readable benchmark reports from P0

handoff.summary: Added the bounded persistent multi-oracle maximal-order profiler. A policy-only manifest selects cases from the 494-case certified corpus; Sage.js selector/dynamic/native, sagelite, direct GP nfbasis/nfinit, Hecke, Oscar, and opt-in Magma adapters emit exact bases, raw samples, stage traces, RSS, version and source metadata, and explicit terminal states. An independent exact verifier canonicalizes rational lattices to the corpus lower-row HNF digest and checks containment, closure, discriminant, and index before accepting timing statistics. All nine quick boundaries returned the same verified corpus lattice.
risks: macOS arm64 was not available. The pure-Node normalization/protocol suite passed on Linux arm64 with Node 22.22.2; RSS and OS address-space enforcement are explicitly unavailable off Linux.

The full integration tier was interrupted after ten minutes because this partial worktree lacks the bootstrapped FLINT/FFLAS/M4RI headers and artifacts and public-sparse-random retained a pending promise. The clean optional-native build passed, the compiler suite passed with the existing FLINT addon, and focused profiler/corpus tests pass.

Internal local-prime and basis-merge timings remain trace-not-exposed until the public maximal-order implementation emits structured stage hooks; external CAS public APIs cannot expose those internals reliably.
next_steps: Cherry-pick the lane commit after the integrated corpus commit and optionally add a central package.json benchmark script for tools/number-field-maximal-order/cli.cjs.
Connect structured factor-discovery, local-prime, local-order, and basis-merge trace hooks from the maximal-order engine to the Sage.js worker without changing report or corpus schemas.
Run the baseline and mandatory bad-generator profiles on the fully bootstrapped integration branch; use the explicit timeout/invalid states to prioritize the remaining implementation gaps.
